conviction_note: Near-null: the only company-level lean is that Q2 operating leverage fades (all-store sales growth about halves from Q1 while the cost base keeps growing about 3.5%), which points to a Q2 operating profit flat to slightly down and an H1 a percent or two under the 16,400m plan. That rests on public 月次 and Komeri's record is to hold its full-year plan at H1, so p_up sits at 48 on a 2.3% scale. bar: Company H1 (Apr-Sep) plan OP 16,400m / ordinary 16,350m, held at Q1 (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/8218_20260728_act_20260728_153016_3, 2026-07-28). That implies Q2 OP of about 5,517m. The IFIS Q2 consensus dated 2026-07-27 is OP 5,500m / ordinary 5,600m, so the company guide and the IFIS estimate agree. FY plan: OP 24,000m / ordinary 23,900m. The IFIS FY ordinary consensus is 24,200m, per kabuyoho on 2026-10-26 (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=8218), so the street is already about 1.3% above the plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged from the prior read, as of 2026-10-26 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per baseline). 信用倍率 0.66: margin shorts exceed margin longs. That fits retail fading the July spike to a 20-year high, and it leaves a mild squeeze tail on an in-line print. No options and no skew. Run-up: +1.03% over 20 days, -1.26% over 5 days. Spot was 3,890 at 10:19 JST on 10-27, -2.5% on a day the Nikkei was +2.2% (kabutan quote header). The selling has no visible cause, so it is worth 0. IFIS target price 3,950, about at spot.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jul-Sep) operating leverage fades. All-store sales ran 101.5 / 104.6 / 100.9 (about +2.3% for the quarter) against Q1's 106.1 / 109.7 / 98.6 (about +4.6%), and September was existing-store 100.0 on customers 95.3, with rain hurting gardening and agriculture lines. In Q1, SG&A rose 3.5% (equipment +6.6%, mostly new Kansai DC depreciation) against revenue +4.9%. With that cost base carried into Q2 and Q2 revenue growth around 2-3%, Q2 OP lands roughly flat to slightly down YoY (LY 5,352m) against the 5,517m the H1 plan implies and IFIS 5,500m, and H1 OP comes in about 16,000-16,400m against the 16,400m plan. The counterweight is already netted into the size: H1 ordinary progress against the FY plan would still read about 67-68%, above the 5-year average of about 64.7% that kabutan's headline uses.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY25 (2024-10-22): Q2 ordinary -9.5% YoY and FY progress 59.4% against a 65.5% 5-year average, FY plan held. Stock -5.54% next session (Yahoo bars: 3,520 -> 3,325). H1 FY26 (2025-10-28): Q2 ordinary +12.1%, H1 2% over plan, FY held. Stock +1.29% (3,095 -> 3,135). Q1 FY27 (2026-07-28): beat plus a new 8.8bn yen buyback, +11.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: The 月次 are public, so the slower sales are visible. The cost side is not in them: the consensus Q2 OP of 5,500m (dated 07-27) is +2.8% YoY, which assumes the leverage holds. If the market had worked through the cost base, the IFIS Q2 number would sit near last year's 5,352m. This is an inference from public series, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The Q1 presentation SG&A table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260728500773.pdf, 2026-07-28) supplies the cost side. It is a different document, but both legs are company-published, and the bar comes from the IFIS/Monex page (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/8218_20260728_act_20260728_153016_3).

findings.finding: The 2026-07-28 buyback (up to 2.2m shares / 8.8bn yen, to 2027-03-24, with 2.2m shares to be cancelled 2027-03-31 whatever is bought) is 34% used: 769,900 shares and 2.99bn yen by 2026-09-30. That leaves about 5.8bn yen, about 2.8% of a 209bn yen market cap, buying in the market through any post-print weakness.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement on 2026-07-28 drew +11.98% (together with a Q1 beat). Ongoing execution has no separate reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: The programme itself is public and priced. What is not is the buying it puts under a soft print the next session: about 1bn yen a month at the September pace, roughly 50m yen a day, about 15% of the 325m yen median daily turnover (baseline). That cushions the downside tail more than it moves the median.
findings.independence: The kabutan/MINKABU Q1 article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8218&b=n202607281099) confirms the terms. It is the same programme, so there is no independent second signal.

outside_window.finding: Cancellation of 2.2m treasury shares (4.65%) on 2027-03-31, committed whatever the buyback achieves.
October 月次 (due about 2026-11-02) would show whether September's rain-hit flat existing-store sales persisted.
